poc_details: Scope: 2-week POC using Hosted API rerank endpoint. Deliverables: (1) run offline scoring of 50k query-doc pairs to compute baseline NDCG, (2) integrate rerank endpoint for real-time top-50 reordering, (3) measure P95 latency and throughput at 10-20 qps, (4) cost estimate for Dedicated pilot. Evaluation metrics: NDCG@10, MRR, P95 latency. Data: anonymized production queries + synthetic hard negs. Success criteria: >= 10% uplift in NDCG@10 vs current lexical baseline and P95 <= 150ms for rerank call.
